dedupe_keys.name: fna ilo simulate digital twin for payment system stress testing

description: A commercial digital twin of payment networks for central banks and system operators. The FNA page says ILO Simulate uses network science to build a digital twin that replicates a payment network, its participants' behaviour and historical data as a virtual RTGS test environment, so operators can simulate forward scenarios, predict contagion and test resilience against severe economic shocks, coordinated cyber attacks or simultaneous participant defaults, such as a major clearing bank outage, before changing live rules. It is sold on request with demos, not as a free download; pricing and licence terms are not stated on the page read. Coverage is any payment system that adopts it. Caveats: the page is marketing material with no method detail. For simulation it shows how an operator outage or cyber attack spreads through a payment network. A related catalogue record is PSSimPy.
